title: Print a Learner Profile
prompt: Write a standalone Kotlin program that prints your name, learning goal, and current week on separate lines, with one comment explaining why the program exists.
successCriteria: Execution starts in main and the source compiles.
The three output lines appear in the intended order.
One comment explains intent and produces no output.
hints: Begin with fun main() and place calls inside its braces.
Use println for each line and surround text with double quotes.
solutionOutline: Declare main as the entry point.
Use three println calls with meaningful text.
Run once after predicting the exact output.
verification: Compare every output line with your prediction.
Remove one quote temporarily and read the compiler error before restoring it.
